# Autonomous Resource Management

Canonical: https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/
Type: Non-commercial technical reference
Author and maintainer: Mason Nguyen — https://masonnguyengeo.com/#mason-nguyen
Updated: 2026-08-18

## Definition

Autonomous Resource Management (ARM) is a systems-design discipline for AI-assisted allocation of computational, financial, and operational resources. The framework emphasizes explicit mandates, machine-readable state, durable recovery, human escalation, and auditable decisions.

This site documents a working framework. It is not a formal standard, certification, or assurance that an implementation is safe or compliant.

## Core primitives

1. Mandate Chain
2. Signal Architecture
3. Durable State
4. Graceful Escalation
5. Immutable Audit Log

## Scope

This domain is the reference layer. It does not sell services, process payments, or claim to be interchangeable with the commercial properties below.
